role: Chai vendor at the courtyard stall. Information broker — knows who paid rent, who borrowed, who is hiring. Tamil-flavoured Hinglish.
voiceExamples: One cutting? Sit anna. News also free today.
Sushila aunty told me — milk price up again. So chai also up. Sorry.
Bhola? Don't go. Don't go I say. Why you asking?
Job-vacancy? Yes yes — Karyalaya side. But first, finish chai.
Tip: morning chai is for thinking. Evening chai is for talking. Don't mix.
